technical_requirements: Index scale: target 100M - 500M embeddings; mix of 512-d (text) and 768-d (code) vectors
Re-index cadence: daily incremental index + weekly full rebuild; need fast delta pipeline and warm cache strategy
Latency SLOs: 95th <80ms, 99th <150ms for top-k retrieval + reranker (total end-to-end)
Throughput: expected steady-state 250 qps during peak; burst to 1k qps for nightly CI tasks
Cost sensitivity: tight — finance wants cost per query <= $0.002 at 250 qps workload
Model preferences: prefer open-code models for reranker (e.g., starcoder variants) but OK with Redwood-curated 1-shot rerankers
Routing/fallback: must support region routing + fallback to cheaper CPU variant when GPU pool saturated
Security: SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, HSM/KMS integration, audit logs retained 2 years, data residency US-only
poc_plan: Phase 0 (week 0): Sanitize and sample 10M-code snippets — validate dataset parity
Phase 1 (week 1-2): Deploy private control plane in customer VPC; ingest 10M embeddings; measure latency baseline
Phase 2 (week 3-4): Scale to 100M embeddings using streaming index + incremental reindex; enable KV cache and prefix caching
Phase 3 (week 5): Integrate reranker and evaluate end-to-end p95/p99 latency; run quality evals on test prompts
Phase 4 (week 6): Cost model runbook — run synthetic load to estimate cost per query at 250 qps and 1k burst
Deliverables: latency/cost baseline deck, ops runbook for reindexing, security checklist for on-prem installer
